Kamehameha.name: Kamehamera
Kamehameha.desc: The Turtle School's signature wave, taught by Master Roshu.

DestructoDisc.name: Destro Disc
DestructoDisc.desc: A razor-thin spinning disc of ki that cuts through anything.

SolarFlare.name: Solar Flash
SolarFlare.desc: A blinding flash that stuns everyone facing you.

TriBeam.name: Triad Beam
TriBeam.desc: Tenzo's devastating triangle blast. Costs a lot of ki.

Kaioken.name: Kaiyoken
Kaioken.desc: An independent technique: toggle it in Forms / Techniques or with K. Combine it with a Saiyar form while keeping your beam equipped. Extra power costs continuous Ki and health; a cooldown follows. Train Kaiyoken x10 to unlock the higher intensity.

SpiritBomb.name: Spirit Sphere
SpiritBomb.desc: Gather energy from all living things into one giant sphere. Takes a long charge.

Masenko.name: Masenka
Masenko.desc: A quick overhead beam Piccor taught Gohin.

FinalFlash.name: Final Blaze
FinalFlash.desc: Vegara's all-out beam, fired with both palms.

BigBangAttack.name: Big Burst Attack
BigBangAttack.desc: A single overwhelming sphere of ki.

DeathBeam.name: Doom Beam
DeathBeam.desc: Frigor's fingertip laser. Fast and precise.

Regeneration.name: Regeneration
Regeneration.desc: Restore lost health by spending ki.

CandyBeam.name: Sweet Beam
CandyBeam.desc: Turn a weakened enemy into candy.

InstantTransmission.name: Instant Transfer
InstantTransmission.desc: Taught by the Yardrats: lock onto a ki signature and teleport. Lets you travel to any world you have visited.

Afterimage.name: Afterimage Technique
Afterimage.desc: Move so fast you leave an image of yourself behind.

FusionDance.name: Fusion Step
FusionDance.desc: The Metamoran dance. Perfect poses fuse two fighters for thirty minutes.

Hakai.name: Hakaido
Hakai.desc: A God of Destruction's erasure. Beeros allows only the worthy to learn its basics.

GodKi.name: God Ki Control
GodKi.desc: Wiss's training: calm, efficient ki. Your ki drains more slowly while transformed.

UltraInstinctSign.name: Ultra Intuition -Sign-
UltraInstinctSign.desc: Brief focus with a small dodge chance and no transformation stat boost. Much weaker than an Ultra Intuition form.

UltraInstinctAvatar.name: Ultra Intuition Energy Avatar
UltraInstinctAvatar.desc: Manifest a giant energy body for 60 seconds. It strikes a wide area in front of you. Requires learned Avatar training and active Perfected or True Ultra Intuition; 120-second cooldown.

EnergyField.name: Energy Field
EnergyField.desc: A ki barrier that blocks blasts. Taught by Jiran's rival, Toppa.
